dashboard.title: Your cupping studio

intro.title: From the cup to a score you can trust
intro.why: A coffee's score shouldn't be a black box. Cata Café makes every evaluation rigorous, traceable, and faithful to the SCA CVA protocol.
intro.what: Run CVA cuppings —descriptive, affective, or combined—, solo or in a group, and get a verifiable, exportable score.
intro.how: Create a session, evaluate cup by cup, and review a transparent score you can audit and compare.
intro.calcLead: Every affective score uses the official SCA CVA formula. No hidden math:
intro.calcSigma: sum of the 8 affective sections (fragrance, aroma, flavor, aftertaste, acidity, sweetness, mouthfeel, and overall), each from 1 to 9.
intro.calcU: non-uniform cups; each subtracts 2 points (only with 5 cups).
intro.calcD: defective cups; each subtracts 4 points (a defective cup is also non-uniform).
intro.calcAnchors: Anchors: all eight sections at 5 give 79.00; all eight at 9 give 100.00.
intro.calcRounding: The result is rounded to the nearest 0.25.
intro.calcGroup: In groups, the community score averages the included evaluations and applies per-cup normalized penalties.
intro.calcPerResult: Every result carries its own “How was this calculated?” breakdown with your exact numbers.
